title: Falcons ink former Chiefs OT to 1-year deal after Kaleb McGary retires

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Falcons ink former Chiefs OT to 1-year deal after Kaleb McGary retires
sources.description: The Falcons lost their starting right tackle, Kaleb McGary, to retirement. They wasted little time adding Jawaan Taylor as a veteran replacement.
